verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents workflow automation (triggered workflows, Blueprints, bank rules), but nothing in the pack shows versioning, change review, or rollback for those automations. The audit trail on the features page is a general accounting record, an adjacent feature rather than automation version control. Bank Rules API update and reorder operations are developer building blocks, not versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
